# Folio 1.0-beta2

Folio 1.0-beta2 is a Linux amd64 prerelease. The selected application and
certificate workflows were accepted on Ubuntu 24.04 amd64. Other operating
systems and architectures are not included in this acceptance scope.

## Install

On Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 with systemd:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Aoody743/Folio/releases/download/1.0-beta2/install-1.0-beta2.sh | sudo bash
```

A fresh one-command installation enables the reviewed software and
website/certificate Agent modules. Upgrades preserve an existing Agent policy.
Use `--no-managed-features` to skip default module setup or `--prefix` for a
non-privileged local installation. Pass bootstrap options with `bash -s --`,
for example `curl -fsSL .../install-1.0-beta2.sh | sudo bash -s -- --no-managed-features`.

## Included workflows

- Managed Node.js and Go application runtimes, source archive deployment and
  updates, public HTTPS Git imports, and SSH imports pinned to a host key.
- DNS credential create/rotate/delete actions with masked reads, plus the
  implemented HTTP-01 and DNS-01 order/recovery flows.
- Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 package catalog verification for Git, Node.js and Go.

phpMyAdmin and pgAdmin remain unavailable because their managed web lifecycle
adapters are not implemented. Real DNS provider accounts and public CA issuance
were deferred; local protocol fixtures do not count as provider acceptance.
Private Git repository authentication is not supported.

The release assets include the Linux amd64 archive, the one-command installer,
and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
